additionalAdversarialProbe.case: purchase deadline expires after final simulation begins but before wallet send

reviewedSafeguards: Capability getter and independently verified EIP-712 domain gate permit use; known previous engines keep the separately reviewed approval flow.
Permit binds the current owner, configured engine spender, token, exact aggregate price, nonce, Base chain and immutable purchase deadline; recovered signer must match the owner.

Unsigned review makes no unapproved opening simulation and no transaction. First explicit confirmation signs only, then simulates and estimates the complete signed call; second explicit confirmation sends one engine transaction.
Fresh registry, price, supply, token balance, ETH balance, VRF ceiling, nonce and domain checks precede signing and send. A consumed permit is accepted only with sufficient exact-price allowance.
Latest wallet, account and chain are checked across awaits, with a synchronous expiry/review/wallet fence immediately before send. Double clicks are serialized.
Permit signature and calldata stay in memory; persisted receipt tracking contains only transaction identity and request expectations, including replacement tracking.
Actual transaction calldata and exact request receipts retain batch grouping/count checks; only successful chain receipts confirm. Pending or reverted transactions do not claim a reveal.
Unsupported or rejected permits never send an automatic fallback approval; separate approval is an explicit fresh review.

correctedFinding.problem: Expiry during the awaited final preflight could reach wallet.sendTransaction after the initial expiry check, causing an avoidable deadline-reverted transaction.
correctedFinding.correction: The final synchronous expiry, exact review and current wallet/account/chain fence runs after the last awaited preflight and immediately before wallet entry.
correctedFinding.authorAdditionalRegression: Expiry during final getAddresses preflight also refuses before wallet entry.

limits: The independent browser executes the real hook, Button and receipt code using synthetic local signing keys and mocked RPC/wallets. It does not establish mainnet permit acceptance.
The contract, unsigned package and owner activation have their own separate reviews and deployment gates. This verdict covers the finite buyer source files above.
The browser runner uses a separate Vite cache/output and preserves the author report; its extra test expires the purchase during the final simulation and counts attempts at wallet entry.
